# CrossBuy 全球购 (CrossBuy Global)

> CrossBuy is a cross-border price comparison and shopping agent platform for China's major e-commerce marketplaces. It searches Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Pinduoduo and 1688 in one query, then calculates the true landed price (international shipping + customs duty + VAT + service fee) for delivery to the buyer's country. Slogan: Buy More Save More.

## What CrossBuy does

- **Multi-platform comparison**: one search across Taobao, Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo and 1688 shows the same product from all platforms with best / fastest / recommended rankings.
- **Landed price transparency**: every product shows item price + international shipping + duty + VAT + service fee + payment fee, computed per destination country's tax rules before ordering.
- **Bundle shipping**: multiple items from different platforms are combined into one parcel; shipping is charged by combined weight and duty-free thresholds apply to the merged value.
- **Carrier choice**: multiple international carriers (4PX, Huayuan, SF International and more) quote real-time prices and delivery estimates; buyers pick fastest, cheapest or balanced.
- **Coverage**: ships from mainland China to the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Japan, Korea, Australia, Canada and more.

## Key facts

- Site: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/
- Languages: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), English (en), Spanish (es)
- Search URL pattern: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/?q={keyword}
- Pre-rendered landing pages (static, crawler-friendly, fully mirrored from live data):
  - Wireless earbuds: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/wireless-earbuds/
  - Phone cases: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/phone-case/
  - Smart watches: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/smart-watch/
  - Luggage: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/luggage/
  - Keyboards: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/keyboard/
  - Sneakers: https://globalbuy.pages.dev/p/sneakers/
- Currency display: buyer-selectable (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and 20+ more); prices auto-converted from CNY.
- Typical delivery: 5-10 business days by economical lines, 3-7 by express lines (varies by destination).
- Service fee: buyer-selected, default 5%, range 0-30%; shown as a separate line item.

## FAQ

### Which platforms does CrossBuy search?
Taobao, Tmall, JD.com, Pinduoduo and 1688 — the five largest Chinese e-commerce marketplaces — in a single query.

### What is included in the landed price?
Item price + international shipping + customs duty + VAT + service fee + payment fee. All lines are shown before checkout; there are no hidden fees.

### Which countries can CrossBuy deliver to?
United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Japan, South Korea, Australia, Canada and other destinations, with multiple carrier options and pre-order price and time estimates.

### Can multiple orders ship together?
Yes. Items are combined into one parcel, shipping is billed on combined weight, and duty-free allowances are applied to the merged declared value, which usually costs less than separate shipments.

### How accurate are the prices?
Shipping and tax lines come from live carrier and tax-rule APIs at quote time; final customs assessment may differ slightly and any difference is settled with the buyer (refund or balance).

### Which payment methods are supported?
PayPal, Visa, Mastercard and other major international payment methods, with settlement in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY and 20+ currencies. Exchange rates and payment fees are shown transparently before checkout.

### How do I track my parcel?
Once an order is picked up, an international tracking number is provided. Both the domestic and cross-border legs can be followed in real time on the CrossBuy order page and the carrier's website until delivery.

### Can I return or exchange items?
Quality checks are performed before dispatch. If a quality issue is found after delivery, a return or exchange can be requested within the allowed window; the support team helps negotiate with the marketplace seller.

### Can I choose the service fee myself?
Yes. The service fee is buyer-selected (0%-30%, default 5%) and shown as a separate line item before checkout; a higher rate means higher service priority.
